changes.reason: Concurrent ISR fill waiters render their own responses when the fill response contains Set-Cookie, private, or no-store. The policy uses Fetch headers and the existing cache contract on every host.

kubernetes.reason: Node composition uses the common ISR response policy with the selected cache store.
constraints: Cross-process durability requires a durable store. Local tests do not verify a Kubernetes deployment.

aws-lambda.reason: Lambda composition uses the common ISR response policy before serializing its invocation response.
constraints: In-memory caching is scoped to warm instances. Local handler tests do not verify a deployed Lambda or live Redis.

cloudflare.reason: Workers composition uses the common Fetch response policy with no additional runtime binding.
constraints: The in-memory store is isolate-local. Durable caching requires a Worker-safe store. Local handler tests do not verify a deployed Worker or durable Worker store.
